name: Grace
source:
Magda's roommate and one of her few friends. Grace is very loyal to the Haven's rules but also compassionate towards other people.

[spoiler]She saved Magda by speaking up for her during Magda's Apologia Assembly, but is now very watchful for any rulebreaking on Magda's part.[/spoiler]
